title: Income-tax Act — Section 80E (Deduction in respect of interest on loan taken for higher education)

content.overview: Section 80E allows a deduction from gross total income: Deduction in respect of interest on loan taken for higher education.

content.study: Chapter VI-A deduction. Section 80E: Deduction in respect of interest on loan taken for higher education. The deduction is allowed from gross total income subject to the conditions, limits and mode-of-payment rules in the section, and it cannot create a loss under the head.
